prompt:
Write a JavaScript function `twoSum(nums, target)` that returns the pair of indices [i, j] such that nums[i] + nums[j] === target.
Output only the JavaScript code without extra commentary.
referenceAnswer: function twoSum(nums, target) { const map = new Map(); for (let i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) { const comp = target - nums[i]; if (map.has(comp)) return [map.get(comp), i]; map.set(nums[i], i); } return []; }
